svg.title: VDJtools: immune-repertoire analysis
svg.desc: A schematic workflow from bulk and paired receptor tables to nine analysis types. Charts are schematic except the recorded VDJdb motif example; the logo shows observed-residue frequency differences against V/J/length-matched background.
